# email — inbox work

> The three parts form one pipeline: `inbox-setup` builds the personal
> triage KB (one-time interview — already done, rerun only when the KB
> goes stale), `inbox-triage` runs verdicts against that KB, and
> `email-core` carries the raw mail mechanics (connect, read, send).

## Choosing a part

| Situation | Part |
|---|---|
| Read, search, draft, or send mail | `parts/email-core/` |
| Full inbox triage run (uses the KB defaults, light-intake) | `parts/inbox-triage/` |
| (Re)build the personal triage knowledge base | `parts/inbox-setup/` (one-time; interactive interview) |

## Rules

- Triage runs use KB-default preferences; ask at most one intake question,
  and only when the answer would change the verdict.
- Verdicts are batched; drafts follow the reply style recorded in the KB.
- Never send without the user seeing the draft unless the KB explicitly
  grants auto-send.
